# BankPlus

> BankPlus offers comprehensive personal and business banking services including checking, savings, loans, mortgages, and digital banking tools.

BankPlus provides a full suite of retail banking products and services for individuals and businesses, with emphasis on digital banking convenience through online and mobile platforms, competitive lending products, and financial management tools like Money Manager and Zelle integration.

## Key Topics

- Personal Banking
- Checking Accounts
- Savings Accounts
- Home Mortgages
- Personal Loans
- Auto Loans
- Debit Cards
- Online Banking
- Mobile Banking
- Zelle Money Transfer
- CreditPlus
- Greenlight
- Home Equity Line
- Money Manager
- Interactive Teller Machine

## Core Banking Products

- [Personal Banking Hub](https://www.bankplus.net/personal): Personal banking hub with checking, savings, loans, Zelle, Money Manager
- [Personal Checking Accounts](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/products/checking): Checking account options: ValuePlus, student, senior accounts with Visa
- [Savings Accounts](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/products/savings): Savings products including Christmas Club and Savings Made Simple accounts
- [Certificates of Deposit](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/products/certificates-of-deposit): Certificate of Deposit investment options with competitive APY rates
- [Personal Banking Products Overview](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank): Personal banking products including checking, savings, debit cards, CDs

## Lending & Mortgages

- [Home Mortgages](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow/home-mortgages): Home mortgages with online application, refinancing, first-time buyer options
- [Personal Loans](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow/personal-loan): Personal loan products with competitive rates and flexible terms
- [Auto Loans](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow/auto-loans): Auto loans for new and used vehicles with competitive flexible terms
- [Home Equity Line of Credit](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow/home-equity-line): Home equity line of credit (HELOC) with variable rates and low APR
- [Real Estate Loans](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow/real-estate-loan): Real estate loans including construction, land acquisition, residential
- [Borrowing Hub](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/borrow): Borrowing hub with personal loans, auto loans, mortgages, home equity

## Digital Banking & Payment Services

- [Online and Mobile Banking](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/services/online-mobile-banking): Online and mobile banking with Zelle money transfers and account management
- [Debit Cards](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/products/debit-cards): BankPlus Visa debit card with contactless payment and Zero Liability
- [Interactive Teller Machine](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/services/interactive-teller-machine): Interactive Teller Machine service combining live teller and ATM convenience

## Specialized Programs & Tools

- [Greenlight Debit Card](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/products/greenlight): Greenlight kids/teens debit card with parental controls and financial literacy
- [CreditPlus Credit-Building Program](https://www.bankplus.net/personal/bank/services/creditplus): CreditPlus credit-building program with small-dollar loans and savings
- [Tuition Payment Options](https://www.bankplus.net/general/tuition-payment-options): Guide to tuition payment options and financial tools at BankPlus

## Optional

- [Refer a Friend Program](https://www.bankplus.net/refer-a-friend): Referral program offering $50 Visa reward for checking account openings
